# Repositories that have their own weekly changelog, one name per line.
#
# A repository belongs here when it does not build from goatcore and goatcore
# does not build from it: a product of its own that connects to a fabric. Its
# pull requests are listed on docs/changelog/weekly/<repository>/<week>.md, and
# the main weekly page carries only its highlights (releases, new capabilities,
# security) with a link to that page.
#
# Every other public repository is part of one story with goatcore and stays on
# the main page. An owner moves a repository by adding or removing its line.
octo-pod
open-billie
